name: spawn_event_effect_attached_to_object

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_SpawnEventEffectAttachedToObject consumes an effect ID and object ID, resolves the object through func_001EAB00, and queues event-effect dispatcher state 10 with the effect ID and resolved object

notes: Dispatcher state 10 loads effect_id from the event-effect package into the D_0035C010 manager through func_00177558, resolves the resulting effect, and starts func_001DE750 when the target object exists. That worker derives the object's attachment transform through func_001317F8 and applies it to the effect through func_00148060. The 18 JP calls in tw09.ard use effect IDs 1 through 6 and object IDs 1 through 3.
